import re

def parse_line(line):
    # Regular expression to match the access log format
    pattern = r'(\S+) - - \[([^\]]+)\] "(\S+) (\S+) (\S+)" (\d+) (\d+|-) (\d+\.\d+)'
    match = re.match(pattern, line)
    
    if not match:
        raise ValueError("Line does not match expected format")
    
    ip, time, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_val, seconds = match.groups()
    
    # Convert status to int
    status = int(status)
    
    # Convert bytes to int, handling "-" case
    if bytes_val == "-":
        bytes_val = 0
    else:
        bytes_val = int(bytes_val)
    
    # Convert seconds to float
    seconds = float(seconds)
    
    return {
        'ip': ip,
        'time': time,
        'method': method,
        'path': path,
        'status': status,
        'bytes': bytes_val,
        'seconds': seconds
    }

def parse_line(line):
    # Regular expression to match the access log format
    pattern = r'(\S+) - - \[([^\]]+)\] "(\S+) (\S+) (\S+)" (\d+) (\d+|-) (\d+\.\d+)'
    match = re.match(pattern, line)
    
    if not match:
        raise ValueError("Line does not match expected format")
    
    ip, time, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_val, seconds = match.groups()
    
    # Convert status to int
    status = int(status)
    
    # Convert bytes to int, handling "-" case
    if bytes_val == "-":
        bytes_val = 0
    else:
        bytes_val = int(bytes_val)
    
    # Convert seconds to float
    seconds = float(seconds)
    
    return {
        'ip': ip,
        'time': time,
        'method': method,
        'path': path,
        'status': status,
        'bytes': bytes_val,
        'seconds': seconds
